_comment: Statutory levies applied on top of landed bullion value. THESE CHANGE WITH EVERY UNION BUDGET AND BY MID-YEAR NOTIFICATION. validate-gold-rates.mjs fails if reviewedOn is older than 180 days.
reviewNote: Total import duty raised 6% -> 15% effective 13 May 2026 (BCD 5%->10%, AIDC 1%->5%). GST is a transaction tax charged at billing and is deliberately EXCLUDED from the valuation rate: the Indian 'gold rate today' convention quotes the pre-GST landed rate, and lenders value pledged gold on the same pre-GST basis. Verified 22 Aug 2026: derived valuation matched the reported national 24K/22K rate to within 0.02%.
